Account.description: The signed-in account, independent of any repository.

admin.description: Runs the server: may approve and disable accounts under `/v1/admin`.

AccountInfo.description: An account as an administrator sees it.

ActivityEntry.description: A file or lock event from the audit log.

action.description: checkout, release, checkin, restore or force_unlock.

key.description: The public key as an OpenSSH line.

title.description: A name for the key; defaults to the key's own comment.

AdminCreateOrgRequest.description: A server administrator or service credential creating an organization for an existing user.

owner.description: An existing active user, who becomes the organization's first owner.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next, older page; null on the last page.

current.description: Required when the account already has a password.

base_revision.description: Revision the caller's copy is at (omit if none); must equal the head.

hours.description: How long the invitation can be used, in hours.

name.description: Shares the namespace with user names: 2 to 39 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`, not reserved.

max_locks_per_user.description: Locks one user may hold; defaults to the server's. A limit in the repository's policy file overrides it.

owner.description:
The namespace to create it in: the caller's own account name, or an organization whose repository-creation
policy lets them. Defaults to the caller.

name.description: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`; unique, and never reused after revocation.

description.description: At most 500 characters; defaults to empty.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters; defaults to the slug.

slug.description: 1 to 39 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`, starting with a letter or digit; unique in the organization.

repos.description: Repositories the token is valid for, as `owner/name`; at least one.

code.description: Give this to the person being invited. Shown once and never stored.

secret.description: Presented as a bearer credential. Shown once and never stored.

token.description: The token to present as a bearer credential. Shown once and never stored.

CreationEffect.description: Whether a creation rule permits or forbids.

CreationRuleInfo.description: A subject holds at most one rule per effect. A matching `deny` beats any `allow`.

subject.description: The team slug, user name, or organization role (`owner` or `member`).

CreationScope.description: Which repository visibilities a rule or policy covers.

CreationSubjectKind.description: What a creation rule's subject names.

reason.description: Shown to administrators; not to the account holder.

ErrorBody.description: Body of every non-2xx response; `code` is stable and machine-readable.

ExternalIdentityInfo.description: A provider identity linked to an account.

email.description: The address the provider last gave, if it vouched for one.

name.description: What to call it on the sign-in button.

sign_in_url.description: Send the browser here (a full page navigation, with an optional `return_to` path) to start signing in.

revision.description: Head revision; absent if the path is locked but has no revision yet.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

reason.description: Why the lock is being removed; required and recorded in the audit log.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next, older page; null on the last page and with `path`.

revisions.description: With `path`: all of that path's revisions, oldest first. Without: newest first.

Limits.description: Limits on one owner. Every limit is opt-in: a null field is unlimited.

members.description: Members an organization may have; always null for a user.

storage_bytes.description: Bytes of distinct content across the owner's repositories.

LimitsListing.description: The server default and every owner that has limits of its own.

defaults.description: Applies to owners with nothing of their own; all null unless the operator configures it.

Me.description: The caller and what they may do in one repository.

role.description: The effective role: the highest of the direct grant, team grants and organization ownership.

MemberCreation.description: What members may create when no rule applies.

MemberSource.description: What decides a member's effective role.

MyLock.description: A live lock the caller holds, with the repository it is in.

OidcLink.description: Where to send the browser to link the provider to the signed-in account.

OrgInfo.description: An organization: a namespace that owns repositories.

oneOf.description: The caller's standing in it (`owner` or `member`); absent when they have none.

OrgRole.description: A person's standing in an organization.

OwnerKind.description: What an owner (a user or an organization) is.

OwnerLimits.description: An owner's limits. Nothing is limited unless an operator sets a limit or a server default.

effective.description: The limits in force: the owner's own where set, else the server default, else null (unlimited).

own.description: Limits set for this owner alone; a null field follows the server default.

OwnerUsage.description: What an owner uses against its limits.

email.description: Required when the server is open and verifies email addresses (`RegistrationInfo.email_verification`).

invite.description: Required when the server is invite only.

status.description:
`active`, or what the account still needs: `pending_verification` (follow the link in the email) or
`pending_approval` (an administrator must approve it).

approval.description: With `open` registration: an administrator approves each new account after it is verified.

email_verification.description:
With `open` registration: sign-up needs an email address, and the account stays inactive until its
link is followed.

lease_hours.description: How long a checkout lasts before it expires unless renewed.

max_locks_per_user.description:
Locks one user may hold in the repository: the policy file's `meta.max_locks_per_user` if it sets one, else
the repository setting, else the server default.

max_locks_per_user_setting.description: The repository setting alone; absent when it follows the server default. Not in force while the policy file sets one.

max_locks_set_by_policy.description: True when `.pyn/pyn.toml` sets the limit; the setting then cannot be changed.

role.description: The caller's role in the repository; absent when they have none.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

RepoPolicyInfo.description: An organization's repository-creation policy. Owners can always create repositories and are not listed in it.

member_creation.description: What members may create when no rule applies; `none` (owners only) is the default.

rules.description: Ordered by kind, subject, then effect.

default_branch.description: Provisional: the single mainline until branches arrive.

files.description: Paths with at least one revision.

locks.description: Live locks with their holders, ordered by path.

updated_at.description: Time of the newest revision; absent for an empty repository.

RepoTeam.description: A team of the owning organization and its role in a repository.

base_revision.description: The current head the caller is looking at; must still be the head.

confirm.description: `<path>@r<base_revision>`, confirming the caller knows which head is being replaced.

revision.description: The older revision whose content becomes the new head.

oneOf.description: The path's mode when the revision was made; absent for revisions that predate recording it.

restored_from.description: Set when this revision restored the content of an earlier one.

created_by.description: The server administrator who created it.

csrf_token.description: Send as the `X-Pyn-CSRF` header on every POST, PUT and DELETE.

SetLimitsRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are; a number sets the limit and `null` returns the field to the server default.

members.description: Organizations only; a user has no member limit.

user.description: The first administrator, who can now sign in with the password.

public_url.description: The address people reach the web app at; verification links use it.

token.description: The one-time setup token from the server's log or its `PYN_SETUP_TOKEN` setting.

SetupStatus.description: Whether first-run setup has happened; carries no secrets.

public_url.description: What setup recorded; before setup, the address the server is configured with.

registration.description: What setup recorded, or the configured default before setup.

server_name.description: Set once setup recorded a name.

SignInOptions.description: How people can sign in to this server.

oneOf.description: The configured external provider; null when the server has none.

password.description: Whether anyone may sign in with a password. When false, server administrators still can.

TeamInfo.description: A team of an organization with its members and repository roles.

TeamRepo.description: A repository where a team holds a role.

repos.description: `owner/name` of each repository the token is limited to; empty means every repository.

oneOf.description: The newest revision at or under the entry (`path` on it names the file). Absent for a file with a lock but no revision.
The live lock on a file; always absent for folders.

path.description: Repo-relative path; pass it as `path` to list a folder.

entries.description: Folders first, then files, each by name.

path.description: The listed folder; empty for the root.

UpdateRepoRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

max_locks_per_user.description: A number sets the limit, `null` returns to the server default. Refused while the policy file sets one.

oneOf.description: Changing it needs the owner with admin rights and is recorded in the audit log.

UpdateTeamRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

members.description: Organization members; null for a user.

stored_bytes.description: Bytes of distinct content, counted once per repository.

token.description: The token from the verification link.

Visibility.description: Public: anyone, signed in or not, may read the repository. Private: members only, and everyone else gets 404.
